newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Chemical to raise synthetic rubber price.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Chemical to raise synthetic rubber price.

text.p: Asahi Chemical Industry Co Ltd said on Friday it will raise its benchmark synthetic rubber price by between 12 yen and 15 yen per kg from the current level of about 140 yen per kg, effective from mid-January.
The price rise for styrene butadiene rubber (SBR) will be the first since the end of 1994, a company spokesman said.
He attributed rising prices of raw materials such as ethylene for the move.
Asahi's action follows Japan Synthetic Rubber's decision to raise synthetic rubber prices last week.
Synthetic rubber is used mainly to make tyres.
Of Japan's total rubber consumption of 1.77 million tonnes in 1995, synthetic rubber accounted for 61.1 percent, according to the Japan Rubber Manufacturers' Association.
